title: "DNA-methylation_preprocessing"
output: html_document

```{r}
library(glue)
library(ENmix)
library(minfiData)

project_dir <- "~/Documents/repos/explant-seq"
DNAm_dir <- glue("{project_dir}/data/DNA/DNA-methylation/2026-06-19")

# if the following line errors out with Basename empty, it is because excel converted the array name to a number with scientific notation
# fix in excel and rerun
sheet <- read.metharray.sheet(glue("{DNAm_dir}/rawdata"), pattern = "csv$")
rgSet <- read.metharray.exp(targets = sheet, extended = TRUE)
```

```{r}
qc <- QCinfo(rgSet, distplot = TRUE)
```

```{r}
plotCtrl(rgSet)
```

```{r}
mdat <- preprocessENmix(
  rgSet,
  bg = "oob",
  dye = "RELIC",
  QCinfo = qc,
  exQCsample = TRUE,
  exQCcpg = TRUE,
  nCores = 4
)
beta <- getB(mdat, type = "Illumina", offset = 100)
multifreqpoly(beta, main = "Beta value distributions")
```


```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(magrittr)

# Check sex prediction
gmSet <- mapToGenome(mdat)
sex_pred <- getSex(gmSet)
sex_pred$predictedSex

sheet$Array_slide <- paste0(sheet$Slide, "_", sheet$Array)
sex_df <- as.data.frame(sex_pred)
sex_df <- tibble::rownames_to_column(sex_df, var = "Array_slide")
sex_df <- sex_df %>% dplyr::left_join(sheet %>% dplyr::select(Sample_Name, Array_slide, Sex), by="Array_slide")

ggplot(sex_df, aes(x = xMed, y = yMed, color = Sex)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(
    x = "Median X chr intensity (log2)",
    y = "Median Y chr intensity (log2)",
    title = "Predicted sex: X vs Y chromosome intensity"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

# Deconvolution

```{r}
library(HiBED)
data("HiBED_Libraries")

# Mset_raw <- preprocessRaw(rgSet)
mSet_noob <- preprocessNoob(rgSet)
betas_for_deconv <- getBeta(mSet_noob)
# strip EPICv2 suffixes back to standard cg IDs before matching
rownames(betas_for_deconv) <- sub("_.*", "", rownames(betas_for_deconv))

HiBED_result <- HiBED_deconvolution(betas_for_deconv, h = 2)
HiBED_result <- tibble::rownames_to_column(HiBED_result, var = "Array_slide")
HiBED_result <- sheet %>% 
  dplyr::select(Array_slide, Sample_Name, Contact_anatomy, Proportion_in_WM) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(HiBED_result, by="Array_slide")

head(HiBED_result)
write.csv(HiBED_result, glue("{DNAm_dir}/HiBED_deconvolution_260810.csv"))
```


```{r}
library(wesanderson)

p_stack
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(paletteer)

df_long <- HiBED_result %>%
  mutate(
    subject   = sub("_.*", "", Sample_Name),
    electrode = sub("^[^_]+_([A-Za-z]+)_.*", "\\1", Sample_Name),
    # combine sample name + anatomy into one label, used directly as the x factor
    contact_label = paste(Sample_Name, Contact_anatomy, sep = "\n"),
    contact_label = factor(contact_label, levels = unique(contact_label))
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Astrocyte, Oligodendrocyte, GABA, GLU, Endothelial, Stromal),
    names_to = "CellType", values_to = "Proportion"
  )


ggplot(df_long, aes(x = Contact_anatomy, y = Proportion, fill = CellType)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") + 
  facet_wrap(~ paste(subject, electrode), scales = "free_x", nrow = 2) +
  labs(
    x = NULL, y = "Cell type proportion (% of tissue)",
    fill = "Cell type",
    title = "Cell type composition by electrode contact",
    subtitle = "Microglia, endothelial cells and stromal cells were removed"
  ) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = cell_type_colors) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```


```{r}
anno <- getAnnotation(mdat)
anno_df <- as.data.frame(anno)
colnames(anno_df)

get_marker_probes <- function(gene, anno_df,
                                regions = c("TSS200", "TSS1500", "1stExon", "5'UTR")) {
  region_pattern <- paste(regions, collapse = "|")
  hits <- anno_df[
    grepl(paste0("(^|;)", gene, "(;|$)"), anno_df$UCSC_RefGene_Name) &
    grepl(region_pattern, anno_df$UCSC_RefGene_Group),
  ]
  rownames(hits)
}

mbp_probes    <- get_marker_probes("MBP", anno_df)
prox1_probes  <- get_marker_probes("PROX1", anno_df)
wfs1_probes   <- get_marker_probes("WFS1", anno_df)
amigo2_probes   <- get_marker_probes("AMIGO2", anno_df)


length(mbp_probes)
length(prox1_probes)
length(wfs1_probes)
length(amigo2_probes)

beta_mbp   <- colMeans(beta[mbp_probes, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
beta_prox1 <- colMeans(beta[prox1_probes, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
beta_wfs1  <- colMeans(beta[wfs1_probes, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
beta_amigo2  <- colMeans(beta[amigo2_probes, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)

marker_df <- data.frame(
  Array_slide = names(beta_mbp),
  MBP = beta_mbp,
  PROX1 = beta_prox1,
  WFS1 = beta_wfs1, 
  AMIGO2 = beta_amigo2
)

marker_df <- merge(marker_df, sheet[, c("Array_slide", "Contact_anatomy", "Proportion_in_WM")], by = "Array_slide")
```

```{r}
cor(marker_df %>% dplyr::select(MBP, PROX1, WFS1, AMIGO2, Proportion_in_WM))
```
